description: On the table there are a red plastic cup, a yellow cup, a small yellow bottle, and a blue scouring pad. The left hand steadies and turns the yellow cup while the right hand presses and rubs the blue scouring pad over the cup’s rim and side, then the right hand sets the pad down and picks up the yellow bottle as the left hand brings the red cup closer; the right hand tips the bottle over the red cup as if dispensing soap for cleaning.
